note: Fern types a method from 200, 201, 202 or 204 only (default only when none is declared), reads JSON, a schema-less entry as typing.Any, before text, takes the first JSON or */* key in declaration order, returns a nullable inline object's model optionally and hoists an inline enum or const response as {Ctx}Response; its SSE-string reference heading is the catalogued stream-reference-return-type, and a str error body from an anyOf of identical strings is union-modelling's collapse
any 2xx response offering text/event-stream and nothing else streams the whole method as SSE, typed by the first success response Fern reads

a content key is JSON when it contains json anywhere (case-sensitively) or is exactly */*, so text/json and Application/json bodies are spread and sent under their own key, and a */* response is typed from its schema
a component used once as a */* or multipart body is inlined like an application/json one: no model, and reference.md lists its properties

a body offering any binary media type is bytes, documents the bytes union and keeps its JSON alternative's model; the alias-of-object half is the catalogued request-alias-reference-parameters departure, unchanged

a */* or application/*+json key sends no content type, any other non-default key always sends itself, an inline object body and a titled $ref object body always keep application/json; the recorded named-union case is union-modelling (Fern types that union typing.Any, which collapses)
a required: false body that is an inline closed empty object is passed whole as a required request: Dict[str, Any], as the same object behind a $ref already was
an inline allOf member carrying its own anyOf of non-object branches is a union to Fern, so the composed body takes neither its properties nor its required
a multipart body always sends data= (empty included) beside files=, and its once-referenced form component gets no model whatever properties it declares

a path union with a member outside Fern's httpx data primitives (an int64, uint32 or uint64 integer, a float number, a dated, uuid or byte string) is converted through convert_and_respect_annotation_metadata before encode_path_param
an error body that $refs a nullable: true component is Optional[Component], as the same reference is in a success response
the first JSON key in declaration order is read, so an application/*+json declared before application/json is the body's media type, and a key holding * names no content type
a success response offering application/geo+json beside text/html is JSON and parsed as its model; text is read only when no JSON key is offered
a success response any of whose media types carries a binary string schema is a download: its JSON alternative hoists no model and gives the method no worked example
an operation whose only success is 207 returns nothing: Fern reads no 2xx status but 200, 201, 202 and 204
a file part's default content type is its encoding contentType up to the first comma, untrimmed; a value part keeps the whole value
a multipart part that is a union of form primitives is sent as the bare value in data=, neither JSON-encoded nor converted
